tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: The page ground — drafting paper in light, deep navy in dark. Never white: the cards are white and need something to sit on.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, tables and panels. The default reading surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card: table headers, code, an inset figure.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers, the only places that also take shadow-popover.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The default hairline. Separates rows and bounds cards. 1px, never 2.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: A rule that has to carry weight: a table head underline, a section break, the drafting grid.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and every figure. Navy rather than black, so it belongs to the ground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, units, captions and secondary text. Still passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder and disabled text only. Never for anything a reader must take in.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Interaction only: links, focus rings, the selected nav row. Never decoration. Used freely, it turns the product corporate.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: The tint behind a selected nav row or a focused field.

tokens.name: state-ok
tokens.usage: On track, logged, connected. Paired with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: state-ok-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind an ok pill.

tokens.name: state-caution
tokens.usage: Behind plan, stalling, estimated. Something to look at, not a fault.

tokens.name: state-caution-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind a caution pill.

tokens.name: state-alert
tokens.usage: Broken streak, missed block, pain at 7 or more. Rare by design.

tokens.name: state-alert-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind an alert pill.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: First data series: the headline metric. Shares the accent hue because it is the primary.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Second series. Violet — a clear hue and lightness step from the cyan, so it survives greyscale. Also the You said provenance chip, which is neither interaction nor status.

tokens.name: series-2-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the You said provenance chip. Keeps accent free to mean interaction and nothing else.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Third series. Amber, opposite the cyan on the wheel.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series. Rose. Four is the ceiling: a fifth line is a second chart.

tokens.name: series-ghost
tokens.usage: Last time, the plan, the projection: context rather than fact. Drawn dashed.

tokens.name: plate-25
tokens.usage: 25 kg plate. Fixed in both themes and in every identity: these are the real IWF colours of a physical object.

tokens.name: plate-20
tokens.usage: 20 kg plate. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: plate-15
tokens.usage: 15 kg plate. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: plate-10
tokens.usage: 10 kg plate. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: plate-5
tokens.usage: 5 kg plate, and the bar collar. Fixed in both themes; needs line-strong around it to read on a light card.

families.mono: "Spline Sans Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: The one page title. Never two on a screen.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Card titles that open a region.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: The exercise name, the answer in a label/value pair.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase tile labels and column heads. Always uppercased in CSS, never typed in caps.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The headline number on a stat tile.

styles.name: figure-l
styles.usage: A secondary tile, or a figure inside prose.

styles.name: figure-m
styles.usage: Every number in a table cell. Tabular by default.

styles.name: figure-s
styles.usage: Dense numerals: axis ticks, set indices, plate weights.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Every gap, pad and inset is one of these; nothing is hand-tuned.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a figure and its unit, an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a pill or chip; between stacked label and value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table row padding. The densest comfortable step.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default card padding and the gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding where the card holds a table or a chart. Also the drafting grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between regions of a page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Above a page title; below the last card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The side gutter on a wide desktop column.

radius.note: Square by intent. The largest radius in the system is 10px, and nothing is a pill except a status dot.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, pills, badges, inputs. Yes, pills: 3px, not 999.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and the selected nav row.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels. The outer edge of the interface.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Status dots and the avatar only. Never a button, never a card.

shadow.note: The interface is built from hairlines, not elevation. One shadow exists, for things that genuinely float.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers over the page. Nothing else takes a shadow.
